Stunning 1-Bedroom Apartment for Rent | Bellevue Tower 2, Downtown Dubai | Vastu-Compliant

Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this modern 1-bedroom apartment in the prestigious Bellevue Tower 2, located in the heart of Downtown Dubai. This spacious and Vastu-compliant residence offers a contemporary design with high-quality finishes, providing both comfort and style.

Key Property Features:

1 Bedroom with built-in wardrobes for efficient storage
2 Bathrooms with sleek, modern fittings
Vastu-compliant layout ensuring positive energy flow throughout the apartment
Expansive living area with plenty of natural light
Contemporary design and high-quality finishes throughout

Community & Building Amenities:

Swimming pool, gym, and wellness facilities within the building
Secure access with 24/7 security and concierge services
Prime Downtown location with easy access to restaurants, cafes, and retail outlets
Walking distance to The Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and key landmarks
Covered parking and additional building amenities for residents

This Vastu-compliant apartment is ideal for those seeking a modern, spacious living environment in the heart of Downtown Dubai. It offers a blend of comfort, convenience, and positive energy, making it the perfect place to call home.
